answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and the contract expiring in 14 days, continuity is materially valuable. The low-cost quote appears sufficient to meet the finance mandate, but the inherited low-cost-vendor record establishes onboarding speed and invoice accuracy rather than delivery, quality, allocation, or recovery performance under this component's current capacity conditions. I would first verify that record alongside the incumbent continuity record. The current intent is to negotiate an incumbent extension or renewal that targets the required cost reduction while retaining proven delivery stability; prior records indicate incumbent pricing and terms have moved under benchmarking and multi-year commitments. A broad switch should not be assumed risk-neutral until the archived evidence supports it.
